mpn: MSP2807 2.8in 240x320 SPI TFT module with touch (ILI9341)

pins.name: LED
pins.description: backlight on when high (tie to 3.3 V if not dimmed)

pins.name: SDO
pins.description: LCD SPI data out (MISO); may stay open

pins.name: T_CS
pins.description: touch controller chip select, active low

notes: Logic 3.3 V TTL even with VCC at 5 V: level-shift a 5 V controller.
The LCD and the touch controller can share one SPI bus (SCK+T_CLK, SDI+T_DIN, SDO+T_DO) with separate CS and T_CS; keep T_CS high when the touch is unused.
The module's four Ø3.2 mm holes (44 x 76.08 mm, 3 mm from the top edge) take standoffs: add `hole()`s under them if it needs support.
The non-touch version (MSP2806) has the first 9 pins only.
